response: Saved Views is available today for every customer on a paid plan. Organizing your work often means rebuilding the same filters, sorts, and groupings again and again. Saved Views removes that repetition by letting you capture any configuration of a list — filters, sort order, grouping, and column layout — and return to it instantly whenever you need it. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to set up dedicated views for sprints, clients, priorities, or personal workflows. Views aren't limited to your own screen either: any saved view can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup instead of recreating it individually. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, planning a sprint, or reviewing a client's backlog, Saved Views keeps your most useful configurations one click away. This update is included in all paid plans at no extra cost, so there's nothing new to purchase or activate. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
